tool_description: Initialize one persistent owner-scoped Collection Memory container. A Collection groups episodes intentionally saved around one fixed topic or purpose.
Provide a Collection Name and Collection Description or Purpose. GHOST creates a stable Collection ID and an empty Collection with its permanent episode-number counter starting at one.
Initialization does not append the current conversation automatically. Use ghost_memory_tag with memory_type collection later when the user explicitly asks to add an episode.
server_instruction: When the user explicitly asks to create or initialize Collection Memory, call ghost_memory_collection_init with the exact user-approved Collection Name and a clear Collection Description or Purpose.
After a successful call, report the returned stable Collection ID, Collection Name, and creation time. Do not claim that an episode was saved during initialization.

field_descriptions.collection_name: The user-defined exact name of the new Collection within the authenticated owner's scope.
field_descriptions.collection_description: The fixed subject, purpose, or scope that the Collection will accumulate over time.
